why: Variant 3 has the cleanest setup for the quotable — she says the word 'jealous' off-mic, he denies it twice, then the line lands as the pivot from argument to making up, exactly where it belongs, and the whole script stays tight where Variant 1 sprawls and re-spikes and Variant 2 undercuts its own vulnerability with the dad-joke bit.
fixes: Cut one of the stacked denials before the quotable ('No. No. That's not— I'm not—' → 'No. That's not—') so the line hits with a single clean breath instead of stepping on itself.
Trim 'Genius move. Really elite work from me tonight.' to just 'Genius move.' — the double self-deprecation deflates the forehead-touch moment that follows.
